caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed on a wooden surface. The pitcher has a round, bulbous body with a narrow opening at the top and a single handle attached from the upper part of the neck to the mid-section of the body on the right side. The main color of the pitcher is an olive green with scattered irregular orange-brown spots and patches. The rim and base of the pitcher appear worn, revealing a reddish-brown color beneath the glaze. The illustration is titled "SMALL PITCHER" in capital letters centered above the pitcher in a grey sans-serif font. The background is plain and light beige, and the wooden surface underneath the pitcher is depicted with grain lines and a natural wood tone.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
